manufacturer_update.manufacturer: Uz-DongJu Paint Co. JV (Asaka; brand 'Royal Paint'; DongJu Industrial (KR) 50% / state 50% until 2024 sale of state stake to Comfort Engineering Group) - most likely local supplier/finisher; actual basecoat technology/resin source (Korean partner, possibly KCC/Noroo) still unconfirmed
manufacturer_update.product_identified: OEM solvent-borne basecoat (2C1B) in GM colour; plant-specific GM Korea-style spec (KR-ADM-xxx / KR-MC-710U)
manufacturer_update.evidence: uzavtosanoat.uz UzAuto Motors page lists 'Uz Dong Zhu Paint' among main UzAuto suppliers (https://uzavtosanoat.uz/en/company/ao-uzauto-motors); Daryo 2024-06-22 (https://daryo.uz/en/2024/06/22/uzbekistans-sama-sell50-stake-ofuz-dongju-paint-for19bn/) says JV founded 1995, makes car paints/sealants/body chemicals under 'Royal Paint', main plant in Asaka, buyer committed to keep products compliant with General Motors standards and OEM requirements; spot.uz 2022-08-26 (https://www.spot.uz/ru/2022/08/26/uzdongju/) on the stake tender. KCC: only a July 2025 cooperation agreement for a planned 335 t/yr automotive paint plant (https://invest.miit.uz/en/posts/the-investment-promotion-agency-and-kcc-corporation-signed-a-cooperation-agreement-on-an-automotive-paint-production-project) - too small/too recent to be the historic basecoat supplier. No PDF document from Uz-DongJu found (site uzdongju.uz per yellowpages.uz, not indexed).
